name: The Verge Clean Reader
description: Ad-free, dark mode article reading on The Verge for TV

params.css: body { background: #0d1117 !important; color: #c9d1d9 !important; } [class*='Ad'], [data-ad], .duet--ad, .c-entry-hero__side-rail, .c-newsletter, .c-related-list, [class*='outbrain'], [class*='taboola'] { display: none !important; } .c-entry-content p, .duet--article p { font-size: 22px !important; line-height: 1.8 !important; color: #c9d1d9 !important; } h1, .c-page-title { font-size: 34px !important; color: #58a6ff !important; line-height: 1.3 !important; } .c-entry-content, .duet--article { max-width: 900px !important; margin: 0 auto !important; }
